headline: Midterms hand Democrats Congress; Dec corn is at $4.47¼ overnight
lead: Democrats took Congress with wins in farm states, but December corn barely moved overnight at $4.47¼. Nobody is pricing the farm bill yet. Today's corn price still comes from harvest supply and export demand.
teaser: Democrats take Congress with farm-state wins, while corn and beans edge up ahead of 7:30 export sales.

one_number.unit: per head, feeder cattle feeding loss
one_number.context: Drovers' Profit Tracker puts feeders at a $328 loss per head and packers now negative. Cattle futures ran flat to lower Wednesday.

sections.title: Grains edge up before export sales
sections.body:
- December corn is at **$4.47¼** overnight and January beans at $12.05¾, both slightly above Wednesday's settles.
- USDA AMS shows Gulf export bids at 92 to 94 cents over December for corn, with weekly export sales due at 7:30 a.m. CT.
sections.so_what: Overnight gains came before the sales report printed.

sections.title: Cattle flat, hogs soft
sections.body:
- December live cattle settled Wednesday at **$218.00**, down 15 cents, and November feeders fell 0.7% to $332.025.
- December hog futures settled at $57.55, down 1.8%, while USDA AMS put the pork cutout at $69.29, down $3.14 on the day.
sections.so_what: Cutout and futures both weakened Wednesday.

sections.title: Crude firms as Hormuz fires continue
sections.body:
- WTI is at **$88.91** overnight, up 0.9% from Wednesday's $88.12 settle.
- Iran's Revolutionary Guard said two tankers and a tugboat took off in the Strait of Hormuz, and Brent is near $94 after the election results.
sections.so_what: Diesel costs stay tied to Hormuz headlines.

outside_the_pit.title: Democrats win Congress with farm-state gains
outside_the_pit.body: New committee leadership next year could reshape the farm bill that never passed this year.

outside_the_pit.title: Democratic wins may mean big ag policy changes
outside_the_pit.body: Both parties say they will try to move a farm bill, but the timing now depends on a new Congress.

outside_the_pit.title: Qatar becomes biggest buyer of U.S. LNG
outside_the_pit.body: Hormuz disruption is shifting gas flows, which feeds into nitrogen fertilizer costs.

outside_the_pit.title: Feeder cattle margins turn deeply negative
outside_the_pit.body: Drovers puts feeders at minus $328 per head and packers now negative, a weak spot in the cattle chain.

watch_list.desc: USDA Weekly Export Sales. Soybean sales under 1 MMT would look soft next to Gulf bids.
Dec corn back under $4.40 would say harvest supply is outweighing the vote and export news.
USDA WASDE and Crop Production, the next look at yields and stocks.
